title: TB in pregnancy
dek: Treat disease in pregnancy — delay kills. WHO HRZE includes PZA. Pretomanid is off; ethionamide and streptomycin are off. BDLLfxC or LZD-substituted 9-month constructs are the 2025 RR off-ramps.
story: Untreated TB disease in pregnancy is worse for mother and fetus than first-line drugs. WHO treats DS-TB with HRZE including pyrazinamide. CDC historically omitted PZA in pregnancy and used 9 months of HR ± EMB; the 2020s overlay has moved toward WHO. Stamp which rule you are under.

Aminoglycosides/streptomycin: fetal ototoxicity — do not. Ethionamide: teratogenicity signal — replace (LZD in the 9-month). Pretomanid: insufficient pregnancy/breastfeeding data — BPaLM/BPaL not recommended. Bedaquiline, linezolid, fluoroquinolones, delamanid, clofazimine have been used; 2025 WHO points pregnant RR-TB toward BDLLfxC or BLMZ-class 9-month recipes.

TPT in pregnancy: 3HR or 6H are the comfortable WHO pair; rifapentine TPT evidence is thinner. Breastfeeding on first-line drugs is generally continued; pyridoxine for the infant if the mother is on INH is the classic add-on.
deep: Congenital TB is rare and ugly; treat the mother, examine the neonate, consider window TPT for the newborn if the mother is still smear-positive.
Nausea of pregnancy plus INH/PZA hepatotoxicity: check ALT, do not reflex-stop RIF.
QTc drugs postpartum can look different as volume of distribution collapses — LZD toxicity can rise.
Do not withhold CXR with shielding if disease is in question. A missed cavity is not a radiation-sparing victory.

example.title: Newly pregnant on week 4 of BPaLM
example.setup: RR-TB, FQ-S, BPaLM started; pregnancy test now positive at ~6 weeks gestation.

steps.title: Stop pretomanid
steps.body: The BPaLM eligibility gate failed. Remaining on Pa is not “almost done so it’s fine.”

steps.title: Rebuild a complete regimen today
steps.body: BDLLfxC or BLMZ-class 9-month, FQ-S so keep a FQ, drop Pa. Do not leave BDQ+LZD alone for a month.

steps.title: Obstetric co-management
steps.body: QTc, LFTs, fetal monitoring — not a reason to undertreat RR-TB.

example.takeaway: Pregnancy changes the letters; it does not pause RR-TB.

choices: Withholds all TB drugs until postpartum
check.why: CDC may historically differ on PZA — label the overlay.

check.prompt: BPaLM in a breastfeeding person with RR-TB is:
choices: WHO first choice because Pa is proven safe in milk
Not the WHO BPaLM recommendation (Pa safety insufficient); use a Pa-sparing construct such as BDLLfxC
Required because pregnancy induces rpoB S450L
check.answer: Not the WHO BPaLM recommendation (Pa safety insufficient); use a Pa-sparing construct such as BDLLfxC
check.why: The 2025 off-ramp exists so you do not improvise two drugs.

check.prompt: On the pregnancy constellation, which cluster is the RR-TB off-ramp?
choices: no pretomanid together with BDLLfxC / BLMZ 9-mo
check.answer: no pretomanid together with BDLLfxC / BLMZ 9-mo
check.why: Those terms are the designed replacements.
